# Gurudatta Trading Co.

> Mumbai-based manufacturer and supplier of Compression, Extension and Torsion springs (Mild Steel, Stainless Steel, Music Wire, and other alloys), operating since 2000. Also publishes a free online Spring Rate Calculator with a live 3D preview.

Gurudatta Trading Co. designs and manufactures custom coil springs to customer specification and also supplies from stock. Headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 84549 95315. Email: connect.gtc5@gmail.com.

## Tools

- [Spring Rate Calculator](https://industrialspringmanufacturer.com/calculator.html): Free browser-based calculator for Compression, Extension and Torsion springs. Enter wire diameter, outer diameter, free length and total coils (exact value or Min–Max range) to get spring rate, safe load, deflection, solid height, stress and a live rotatable 3D preview, in English (inch) or Metric (mm) units. No signup required. Results can be sent as a spec sheet via WhatsApp to request a manufacturing quote.
